note: The house interface set, also described in audio/projects/bcc-llqp/brief/sfx-cues.json. No project has generated them yet, so these two are the studio's first pair and every later film should copy source/sfx/ from here rather than generate its own, so every film clicks the same way. This film places two sounds and asks for nothing more: a tutorial that plays a sound on every pointer move stops being a tutorial.

settings.promptInfluence: high, so the sound stays literal rather than musical
settings.format: WAV 48 kHz stereo, then trim the leading silence to zero

sounds.prompt: A single confirming interface tick. Soft rounded click with a very short upward inflection, dry, no reverb, no melody. Reads as yes without celebrating.
sounds.use: Every click that changes what is on screen, and nothing else: twenty three of them across the film, from Watch in the Study Navigator to the office hours link in Support. Never a hover, never a pointer move, never a scroll.

sounds.prompt: A short restrained transition swell for a corporate explainer. Soft filtered air moving past, low volume, no whoosh, no riser, no impact at the end. Understated.
sounds.use: Once, on the dissolve into the closing frame. It is the only section change in the film the picture does not already carry on its own.
